snippet.title: Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity - Announcement Trailer [EN]
snippet.description:
We're thrilled to announce our newest expansion Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity launching on October 28, 2025.

-Explore the unknown island of Castora
-Discover new builds with nine new elite specializations
-Hover, dive, and soar faster on your upgraded Skimmer mount
-Pursue six new legendary items: three new weapons, a ring, an accessory, and the long-requested aquabreather! 
-Experience a year's worth of post-launch content updates 

Read more details in our expansion announcement blog:  https://www.guildwars2.com/news/announcing-guild-wars-2-visions-of-eternity

Prepurchase Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity to receive the exclusive Plumed Commodore’s Hat skin and “Eternal Alchemist” title, plus a Chromatic Resin Weapon Skin Choice Box: https://buy.guildwars2.com/visions-of-eternity
